title: Stage 05 Pre-review Gate
description: Stage 5 (Pre-review) gate. Authored by dev-platform after running lint, type-check, and SCA across the merged build output. Stage 6 (peer review) cannot start until this passes. The security_review_required flag is set when the heuristic in scripts/security-heuristic.js fires; downstream tooling consumes security_review_gate to find the conditional security review's verdict.

lint_passed.description: Project lint command exited cleanly across all areas. Failure routes the fix to the owning dev.

tests_passed.description: Unit tests in the integrated branch pass. Stage 7 (QA) re-runs the full suite with criterion mapping.

dependency_review_passed.description: SCA found no high or critical findings in new/changed dependencies.

security_review_required.description: When true, a conditional security-engineer review is mandatory before Stage 6; trigger heuristic in scripts/security-heuristic.js.

security_review_gate.description: Optional path or identifier of the security-review gate file when security_review_required is true.
